name: omaCortex
author: anonb3ll
description: A private, local memory of your day: which windows you worked in, what you watched, listened to and read, the files you opened. Stays on this machine, finds the thing you half remember, and is available to your agents over MCP.

barWidget.description: Where was I? Today's sessions, media and files, with pause and forget controls.

schema.label: Refresh the bar icon every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar icon re-reads the recorder's state. The panel refreshes on its own while it is open.
